scripts.bs-scss: sass --no-source-map --silence-deprecation=import,color-functions,global-builtin,if-function src/bootstrap.scss:assets/vendor-bootstrap.css && postcss assets/vendor-bootstrap.css --replace --no-map --use autoprefixer && minify assets/vendor-bootstrap.css > assets/vendor-bootstrap.min.css && shx rm assets/vendor-bootstrap.css
scripts.swiper: shx cp node_modules/swiper/swiper-bundle.min.js assets/vendor-swiper.bundle.min.js && shx cp node_modules/swiper/swiper-bundle.min.css assets/vendor-swiper.bundle.min.css
